assessment.nobel_worthiness: A major, sustained renovation of Arabic poetic language, joining mythic reach, fragmentation and critical engagement with inherited forms.
assessment.attribution: The prize would recognize Adonis alone for a transformative modern Arabic poetry of intellectual and formal ambition.
assessment.maturity: The representative collections indicate a long-established body of work with unusual historical consequence and continuing interpretive density.
uncertainties: Assessment of the full Arabic-language corpus depends substantially on translation and critical mediation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: An exceptionally inventive novelistic oeuvre whose encyclopedic structures, tonal range and linguistic energy confront technology, power and historical violence.
assessment.attribution: The citation should credit Pynchon alone for expanding the formal and intellectual possibilities of the contemporary novel.
assessment.maturity: Works from Gravity's Rainbow through Mason & Dixon support a durable achievement rather than a single-book claim.
uncertainties: The breadth of the oeuvre makes comparative judgments about its internal consistency difficult.
This assessment cannot establish coverage of every later work.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visionary, highly patterned prose gives memory, embodiment and the imagination a metaphysical scale while retaining demanding narrative invention.
assessment.attribution: Cărtărescu alone could be cited for an expansive fictional project in which densely wrought form remakes private and historical experience.
assessment.maturity: Blinding and Solenoid point to a mature, coherent project sustained across major works.
uncertainties: The Romanian-language corpus and the effects of translation require further comparative scrutiny.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A radical fictional imagination uses dream logic and estranged narrative to test the limits of psychology, space and causality.
assessment.attribution: The award would recognize Can Xue alone for a singularly experimental reinvention of narrative reality.
assessment.maturity: The representative novels suggest a sustained and unmistakable method rather than isolated formal novelty.
uncertainties: Evaluation outside translated editions requires fuller access to the Chinese-language corpus.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A long fictional career gives divided Korean histories social breadth through layered voices, moral attention and large narrative design.
assessment.attribution: Hwang Sok-yong alone could be cited for fiction recovering the human texture of historical division and social transformation.
assessment.maturity: The span from The Guest to Mater 2-10 indicates both longevity and continued formal ambition.
uncertainties: The extent to which available translations convey the Korean prose style remains uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Bilingual practice makes linguistic estrangement productive across fiction, poetry, essays and drama, yielding a distinctive inquiry into identity and translation.
assessment.attribution: The citation should recognize Tawada alone for inventive writing that turns movement between Japanese and German into a literary form.
assessment.maturity: The range of genres and the representative works show an established, evolving oeuvre of unusual formal coherence.
uncertainties: A comparative judgment must account for the differing reception and accessibility of the Japanese- and German-language work.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Hybrid writing of exceptional intelligence and compression remakes the relations among classical learning, lyric, narrative and visual form.
assessment.attribution: Carson alone could be cited for a genre-crossing oeuvre that brings scholarship and lyric invention into an original modern idiom.
assessment.maturity: Autobiography of Red and Nox represent a body of work whose experiments have developed across forms rather than remaining merely programmatic.
uncertainties: The wide formal range makes a complete assessment of the relative weight of individual genres necessary.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large poetic sequences translate suffering, landscape and collective memory into an ambitious public lyric form.
assessment.attribution: The award would recognize Zurita alone for poetry that gives historical trauma a formally daring and expansive memorial dimension.
assessment.maturity: Purgatory and Anteparadise support the case for a sustained poetic architecture with lasting scope.
uncertainties: The force of the Spanish prosody and visual-scale interventions may be only partly recoverable in translation.
